sections.content: Expressions such as es *necesario* *que*, *hace* *falta* que and es *importante* que are followed by the present subjunctive when the required action has a different subject. This is useful for discussing environmental action.

items.spanish: Es necesario que reduzcamos el consumo de agua.
items.english: It is necessary that we reduce water consumption.
It is important that we recycle more.

items.spanish: Hace falta que protejamos las especies.
items.english: We need to protect the species.

items.spanish: Es necesario que la ciudad mejore el transporte público.
items.english: It is necessary that the city improve public transport.

sections.content: *Hace* *falta* que and es *necesario* que both switch to a bare infinitive once you drop *que* and stop naming who has to act: *hace* *falta* *reducir* el consumo (in general) versus *hace* *falta* que *reduzcamos* el consumo (specifically us).
